taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs to 1 dm, unarmed.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs.

traits.leaf_habit.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves deciduous.

traits.spines.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): unarmed.

traits.stem_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems creeping, the flowering branches erect.

traits.clonal.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems creeping, so a patch spreads.

traits.rosette.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves along creeping stems, no rosette.

traits.leaf_colour.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: leaves bright green.

traits.leaf_division.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves pedately compound.

traits.division_pattern.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): pedately compound: palmate in outline.

traits.division_order.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): three leaflets, the side ones cut nearly to their base, so the leaf reads as five; drawn as five once-divided.

traits.leaflets.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets 3, often appearing as if 5.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): terminal leaflet (1-)1.5-2.5 (to 3.4) cm, so the leaf's blade about as long.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: the fan of the end leaflet and the two deeply cut side ones 3 cm to 5 cm across, from FNA's leaflets 1.2-2 cm wide side by side; from 1.5 cm where the leaflets are the smallest FNA gives (0.8 cm).

traits.leaflet_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): terminal leaflet (1-)1.5-2.5 (to 3.4) cm long.

traits.leaflet_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): terminal leaflet (0.8-)1.2-2 (to 2.5) cm wide.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): terminal leaflet obovate to obovate-rhombic.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): apex rounded to obtuse.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): margins coarsely singly or doubly serrate.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences 1-flowered.

traits.flower_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: open flowers 1.5 cm to 2.5 cm across, petals spreading.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals white, 6-10 mm.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals white; sRGB by eye.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruits 0.6-1 cm, of 3-6 drupelets.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruits red; sRGB by eye.

traits.fruit_shape.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: a small round cluster of a few drupelets.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus pedatus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowering June to August.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: fruit ripe August and September.

appearance.note: Every look comes from the characters through the library's rules: a low creeping carpet of small five-parted toothed leaves, single white flowers on short upright stalks and a few red drupelets.

allometry.note: 0.06 m tall at 3 years in the open, inside the floras' range of heights, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
